dedupe_keys.name: tri drive network 5 bridges series on south australian government data directory

description: Tri Drive Network 5 Bridges (series on South Australian Government Data Directory) is a series of datasets listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Main Roads Western Australia. RAV Network information periodically changes with additions or removal of data and users should confirm that information is current and accurate. The RAV Network Road Tables and RAV Mapping Tool can be found on the Main Roads Western Australia website, refer Hyperlink below. mainroads. wa. gov. au/heavy-vehicles/Main Roads Open Data: Restricted Access Networks opendata. arcgis. Coverage: South Australia. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Main Roads Western Australia. Its tags are HVS, RAV, Tri Drive 1-5, Tri Drive Networks. It offers 7 resource(s) in arcgis geoservices rest api, csv, geojson, html, kml. The portal shows 2026-04-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
